liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lift Off** (1 review): Bobby's voice sounded smooth and buttery after this song, and the band tightened as the night went on [7]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): The band already sounds loose and shredding in the introduction to this song [4]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): Reviewer loved the Mama Tried, Cassidy, St. Stephen run closing the first set [9]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Reviewer highlights West L.A. and Sugaree leading straight into Estimated Prophet and Eyes of the World [9]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer calls this possibly the best version they have heard, and likes the move into Estimated Prophet and Eyes of the World [7]
- **Cold Rain and Snow** (1 review): The video shown with this song was the reviewer's most memorable part of the night [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hey Jude**: rare: 13 archived performances [11]
- **Mama Tried**: rare: 7 archived performances [11]
- **Drums and Space**: rare: 10 archived performances [11]
- **Old News Broadcast**: rare: 10 archived performances [11]
- **Johnny B. Goode**: rare: 13 archived performances [11]

## The recordings

- **deadco2025-05-11** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 2.5/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Commenter says recording quality is great, with few audience chatter interruptions [6]
- **deadco2025-05-11.Bootsy**: source not stated; 21 songs; 174 min [2]
- **deadco2025-05-11.MK41.seedy**: audience recording; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Crowd 1st Set, Crowd 2nd Set [1]
- Reviewer says John Mayer sounded as if microdosed, and Jeff often seemed to play with an extra arm [4]
- Reviewer's first visit to Sphere exceeded expectations as an immersive experience [8]
- Lineup: Bobby Weir, Mickey Hart (percussion, Beam), John Mayer and Oteil Burbridge [1]
- The show fell on Mother's Day at Sphere [2]
- Taped from section 210, row 12, in the middle [3]
- Reviewer ranks this among the best Dead & Company shows ever, with the band sounding wild throughout [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2025-05-11**: taped by Stella Dew; transferred by Stella Dew; source: Zoom iQ7 > iPhone [1]. Also: Recorded on a Zoom iQ7 plugged into an iPhone 11, then converted from WAV through Audacity to FLAC [1]
- **deadco2025-05-11.Bootsy**: taped by Bootsy Jacobs [2]. Also: Transfer was processed through Izotope RX to reduce crowd noise where possible [2]
- **deadco2025-05-11.MK41.seedy**: taped by seedy; transferred by seedy; source: Audience->Schoeps MK41->nbob actives->babyNbox->Sony PCM-A10-cdwav->mp3tag for tagging->recorded by seedy [3]
